texts.NIV84: The sayings of King Lemuel-an oracle his mother taught him:
texts.KJV: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.
texts.NKJV: The words of King Lemuel, the utterance which his mother taught him:
texts.DRB: The words of king Lamuel. The vision wherewith his mother instructed him.

texts.NIV84: "O my son, O son of my womb, O son of my vows,
texts.KJV: What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?
texts.NKJV:
What, my son?
And what, son of my womb?
And what, son of my vows?
texts.DRB: What, O my beloved, what, O the beloved of my womb, what, O the beloved of my vows?

texts.NIV84: do not spend your strength on women, your vigor on those who ruin kings.
texts.KJV: Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.
texts.NKJV:
Do not give your strength to women,
Nor your ways to that which destroys kings.
texts.DRB: Give not thy substance to women, and thy riches to destroy kings.

texts.NIV84: "It is not for kings, O Lemuel- not for kings to drink wine, not for rulers to crave beer,
texts.KJV: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:
texts.DRB: Give not to kings, O Lamuel, give not wine to kings: because there is no secret where drunkenness reigneth:

texts.NIV84: lest they drink and forget what the law decrees, and deprive all the oppressed of their rights.
texts.KJV: Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.
texts.NKJV:
Lest they drink and forget the law,
And pervert the justice of all the afflicted.
texts.DRB: And lest they drink and forget judgments, and pervert the cause of the children of the poor.

texts.NIV84: Give beer to those who are perishing, wine to those who are in anguish;
texts.KJV: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts.
texts.NKJV:
Give strong drink to him who is perishing,
And wine to those who are bitter of heart.
texts.DRB: Give strong drink to them that are sad: and wine to them that are grieved in mind:

texts.NIV84: let them drink and forget their poverty and remember their misery no more.
texts.KJV: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
texts.NKJV:
Let him drink and forget his poverty,
And remember his misery no more.
texts.DRB: Let them drink, and forget their want, and remember their sorrow no more.

texts.NIV84: "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute.
texts.KJV: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.
texts.NKJV:
Open your mouth for the speechless,
In the cause of all who are appointed to die.
texts.DRB: Open thy mouth for the dumb, and for the causes of all the children that pass.

texts.NIV84: Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy." Epilogue: The Wife of Noble Character
texts.KJV: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.
texts.NKJV:
Open your mouth, judge righteously,
And plead the cause of the poor and needy.
texts.DRB: Open thy mouth, decree that which is just, and do justice to the needy and poor.

texts.NIV84: A wife of noble character who can find? She is worth far more than rubies.
texts.KJV: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.
texts.NKJV:
Who can find a virtuous wife?
For her worth is far above rubies.
texts.DRB: Who shall find a valiant woman? far and from the uttermost coasts is the price of her.

texts.NIV84: Her husband has full confidence in her and lacks nothing of value.
texts.KJV: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.
texts.NKJV:
The heart of her husband safely trusts her;
So he will have no lack of gain.
texts.DRB: The heart of her husband trusteth in her, and he shall have no need of spoils.

texts.NIV84: She brings him good, not harm, all the days of her life.
texts.KJV: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.
texts.NKJV:
She does him good and not evil
All the days of her life.
texts.DRB: She will render him good, and not evil, all the days of her life.

texts.NIV84: She selects wool and flax and works with eager hands.
texts.KJV: She seeketh wool, and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.
texts.NKJV:
She seeks wool and flax,
And willingly works with her hands.
texts.DRB: She hath sought wool and flax, and hath wrought by the counsel of her hands.

texts.NIV84: She is like the merchant ships, bringing her food from afar.
texts.KJV: She is like the merchants' ships; she bringeth her food from afar.
texts.NKJV:
She is like the merchant ships,
She brings her food from afar.
texts.DRB: She is like the merchant's ship, she bringeth her bread from afar.

texts.NIV84: She gets up while it is still dark; she provides food for her family and portions for her servant girls.
texts.KJV: She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household, and a portion to her maidens.
texts.NKJV:
She also rises while it is yet night,
And provides food for her household,
And a portion for her maidservants.
texts.DRB: And she hath risen in the night, and given a prey to her household, and victuals to her maidens.

texts.NIV84: She considers a field and buys it; out of her earnings she plants a vineyard.
texts.KJV: She considereth a field, and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.
texts.NKJV:
She considers a field and buys it;
From her profits she plants a vineyard.
texts.DRB: She hath considered a field, and bought it: with the fruit of her hands she hath planted a vineyard.

texts.NIV84: She sets about her work vigorously; her arms are strong for her tasks.
texts.KJV: She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.
texts.NKJV:
She girds herself with strength,
And strengthens her arms.
texts.DRB: She hath girded her loins with strength, and hath strengthened her arm.

texts.NIV84: She sees that her trading is profitable, and her lamp does not go out at night.
texts.KJV: She perceiveth that her merchandise is good: her candle goeth not out by night.
texts.NKJV:
She perceives that her merchandise is good,
And her lamp does not go out by night.
texts.DRB: She hath tasted and seen that her traffic is good: her lamp shall not be put out in the night.

texts.NIV84: In her hand she holds the distaff and grasps the spindle with her fingers.
texts.KJV: She layeth her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.
texts.NKJV:
She stretches out her hands to the distaff,
And her hand holds the spindle.
texts.DRB: She hath put out her hand to strong things, and her fingers have taken hold of the spindle.

texts.NIV84: She opens her arms to the poor and extends her hands to the needy.
texts.KJV: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.
texts.NKJV:
She extends her hand to the poor,
Yes, she reaches out her hands to the needy.
texts.DRB: She hath opened her hand to the needy, and stretched out her hands to the poor.

texts.NIV84: When it snows, she has no fear for her household; for all of them are clothed in scarlet.
texts.KJV: She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
texts.NKJV:
She is not afraid of snow for her household,
For all her household is clothed with scarlet.
texts.DRB: She shall not fear for her house in the cold of snow: for dl her domestics are clothed with double garments.

texts.NIV84: She makes coverings for her bed; she is clothed in fine linen and purple.
texts.KJV: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing is silk and purple.
texts.NKJV:
She makes tapestry for herself;
Her clothing is fine linen and purple.
texts.DRB: She hath made for herself clothing of tapestry: fine linen, and purple is her covering.

texts.NIV84: Her husband is respected at the city gate, where he takes his seat among the elders of the land.
texts.KJV: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among the elders of the land.
texts.NKJV:
Her husband is known in the gates,
When he sits among the elders of the land.
texts.DRB: Her husband is honourable in the gates, when he sitteth among the senators of the land.

texts.NIV84: She makes linen garments and sells them, and supplies the merchants with sashes.
texts.KJV: She maketh fine linen, and selleth it; and delivereth girdles unto the merchant.
texts.NKJV:
She makes linen garments and sells them,
And supplies sashes for the merchants.
texts.DRB: She made fine linen, and sold it, end delivered a girdle to the Chanaanite.

texts.NIV84: She is clothed with strength and dignity; she can laugh at the days to come.
texts.KJV: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.
texts.NKJV:
Strength and honor are her clothing;
She shall rejoice in time to come.
texts.DRB: Strength and beauty are her clothing, and she shall laugh in the latter day.

texts.NIV84: She speaks with wisdom, and faithful instruction is on her tongue.
texts.KJV: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.
texts.NKJV:
She opens her mouth with wisdom,
And on her tongue is the law of kindness.
texts.DRB: She hath opened her mouth to wisdom, and the law of clemency is on her tongue.

texts.NIV84: She watches over the affairs of her household and does not eat the bread of idleness.
texts.KJV: She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.
texts.NKJV:
She watches over the ways of her household,
And does not eat the bread of idleness.
texts.DRB: She hath looked well to the paths of her house, and hath not eaten her bread idle.

texts.NIV84: Her children arise and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praises her:
texts.KJV: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her.
texts.NKJV:
Her children rise up and call her blessed;
Her husband also, and he praises her:
texts.DRB: Her children rose up, and called her blessed: her husband, and he praised her.

texts.NIV84: "Many women do noble things, but you surpass them all."
texts.KJV: Many daughters have done virtuously, but thou excellest them all.
texts.NKJV:
“Many daughters have done well,
But you excel them all.”
texts.DRB: Many daughters have gathered together riches: thou hast surpassed them all.

texts.NIV84: Charm is deceptive, and beauty is fleeting; but a woman who fears the LORD is to be praised.
texts.KJV: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the Lord, she shall be praised.
texts.NKJV:
Charm is deceitful and beauty is passing,
But a woman who fears the Lord, she shall be praised.
texts.DRB: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: the woman that feareth the Lord, she shall be praised.

texts.NIV84: Give her the reward she has earned, and let her works bring her praise at the city gate.
texts.KJV: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.
texts.NKJV:
Give her of the fruit of her hands,
And let her own works praise her in the gates.
texts.DRB: Give her of the fruit of her hands: and let her works praise her in the gates.
